description: Update app/bookings/page.tsx to replace MOCK_TRAVELER_BOOKINGS with real API data via getMyBookings(), add auth gate, map API BookingStatus values to UI tabs, add cancel booking action, and add loading skeleton. This feature is independent of FEAT-001 in terms of UI, but depends on app/lib/api/bookings.ts which FEAT-001 creates — so FEAT-002 must run after FEAT-001.
steps:
1. Update app/bookings/page.tsx. Remove import of MOCK_TRAVELER_BOOKINGS from ./mock. Keep BookingStatus and TravelerBooking type imports from ./mock — they are still needed for the UI components (StatusBadge, BookingCard, EmptyState). Add imports: { useEffect, useState, useCallback } to the existing react import (useCallback may already be unused — add only what's needed); useRouter from next/navigation; useAuth from app/lib/auth-context; { getMyBookings, cancelBooking, type BookingResponse } from app/lib/api/bookings. Keep ApiError available: import { ApiError } from app/lib/api/client.

2. Define a mapping function mapApiBookingToUi(b: BookingResponse): TravelerBooking that converts BookingResponse to TravelerBooking. API statuses → UI BookingStatus: 'CONFIRMED' | 'PAYMENT_PENDING' | 'HELD' | 'CHECKED_IN' → 'upcoming'; 'CHECKED_OUT' → 'completed'; 'CANCELLED' | 'NO_SHOW' → 'cancelled'; 'PENDING' → 'upcoming' (treat as upcoming until confirmed). Fields: id: b.id, hotelId: b.hotel?.id ?? b.hotelId (BookingResponse has hotelId directly and optionally hotel object), hotelName: b.hotel?.name ?? 'Hotel', hotelCity: b.hotel?.city ?? '—', hotelState: b.hotel?.state ?? '—', roomName: b.room?.name ?? 'Room', roomId: b.roomId, checkIn: b.checkIn, checkOut: b.checkOut, nights: calcNights(b.checkIn, b.checkOut) (import calcNights from app/lib/booking), guests: b.guests, totalNgn: b.totalAmount, status: (mapped as above), createdAt: b.createdAt.

3. In BookingsPage component: add auth gate: const { user, isLoading: authLoading } = useAuth(); const router = useRouter(); useEffect(() => { if (!authLoading && !user) router.push('/auth/signin?redirect=/bookings'); }, [authLoading, user, router]). Add data state: const [bookings, setBookings] = useState<TravelerBooking[]>([]); const [loadingBookings, setLoadingBookings] = useState(true); const [fetchError, setFetchError] = useState(''); const [cancellingId, setCancellingId] = useState<string | null>(null). Add fetch effect: useEffect(() => { if (!user) return; setLoadingBookings(true); getMyBookings().then(raw => { setBookings(raw.map(mapApiBookingToUi)); }).catch(err => { const msg = err instanceof ApiError ? err.message : 'Failed to load bookings.'; setFetchError(msg); }).finally(() => setLoadingBookings(false)); }, [user]).

4. Implement handleCancelBooking: async function handleCancelBooking(bookingId: string): void. Set cancellingId(bookingId). Call cancelBooking(bookingId). On success: update bookings state — map the booking with matching id to status 'cancelled'. On error: show a window.alert or a setFetchError with the error message. Finally: setCancellingId(null).

5. Pass cancellingId and handleCancelBooking down to BookingCard. Update BookingCard props type: add onCancel: (id: string) => void and cancellingId: string | null. In the 'Cancel booking' button onClick: call onCancel(booking.id). The button should be disabled when cancellingId === booking.id and show 'Cancelling…' text.

6. Replace the three MOCK_TRAVELER_BOOKINGS references in the stats calculation (counts, nightsStayed, totalSpent, filtered) and the render list with the bookings state variable. The summary strip shows stats computed from bookings state. The tab bar counts come from bookings state. The filtered list is bookings.filter(b => b.status === activeTab).

7. Loading state: when loadingBookings is true, render a loading skeleton instead of the booking list. Skeleton: three rounded cards (height 120px each, background 'var(--tp-muted)', borderRadius '14px', marginBottom '16px') with a pulsing CSS animation. Use a <style> tag for the keyframe: @keyframes pulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1 } 50% { opacity: 0.5 } }. Apply animation: 'pulse 1.5s ease-in-out infinite' via inline style.

8. Error state: when fetchError is non-empty and not loadingBookings, show an error message banner above the tab bar: 'Failed to load bookings: {fetchError}. Please try again.' styled with background #fee2e2, color #dc2626, padding, borderRadius.

9. Ensure no 'any' types anywhere in the updated file. The mapApiBookingToUi function must be typed with explicit BookingResponse → TravelerBooking signature. calcNights is imported from app/lib/booking.
acceptance_criteria: app/bookings/page.tsx imports getMyBookings and cancelBooking from app/lib/api/bookings, not from mock
mapApiBookingToUi correctly maps CONFIRMED/HELD/PAYMENT_PENDING/CHECKED_IN → 'upcoming', CHECKED_OUT → 'completed', CANCELLED/NO_SHOW → 'cancelled'
Auth gate redirects unauthenticated users to /auth/signin?redirect=/bookings
Cancel booking button calls cancelBooking API and optimistically updates UI status to 'cancelled'
Loading skeleton renders three placeholder cards while fetch is in progress
npx next build exits with code 0, zero TypeScript errors
